content.short: RockawayX combines venture investing, a large Solana validator business and curated DeFi vaults on Morpho.
content.description: RockawayX works in several parts of crypto at once. As an investor, it backs early-stage teams. As an operator, it runs dozens of Solana validators from its own data centres. In DeFi, it supplies liquidity across many protocols and curates lending vaults on Morpho, using institutional risk frameworks to pick markets and set limits. It was a seed backer of Solana, has run Solana infrastructure since 2020, and operates as a solver for intent-based protocols. Its Catapult programme incubates and funds real-world asset projects.
content.meta: Venture investor, Solana validator operator and Morpho vault curator under one firm. Explore RockawayX on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
